title: Internalization of Advertising Services: Testing a Theory of the Firm
authors: Birger Wernerfelt; Alvin J. Silk; Shuyi Yu
eligible_reason: Cross-sectional test of a theory of the firm: OLS of the share of each of nine advertising activities performed in-house (q1) on specialization and frequency measures (q2, q5), their interaction and population, with activity and SIC dummies, across 79 firms; descriptive time series of internalization in Section 4. No binary staggered treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: regressions.do (Tables 5-6, Appendix A1-A5): regress q1 cq2 cq5 inter population plus _Iquestions_* / _Isic_* / _Isubjects_* dummies on fulltable.csv (subjects x questions). statistics.R (Tables 3-4) and figures.R (Figures 2-5, time series). The archive also contains publication_codes.rar (82 MB), a search-model / personalized-pricing codebase (model_simulated, model_different_costs, model_nosearch, model_pricing ...) that does not match this paper's content; the files listed in readme.txt do match.
data_files_note: Survey responses (79 firms x 9 activities) and aggregate series shipped.
data_provenance_note: Survey data as collected; moot because the design is cross-sectional.
software_notes: Stata 16.1 (regressions), R 4.0.3 (statistics, figures); the unrelated rar contains MATLAB.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run. publication_codes.rar inside the archive appears to belong to a different project (consumer search model with personalized pricing); package_mismatch left false because the README-listed files match this paper.
